caption:
Three of the World's Top Consciousness Scientists Say AI Isn't Conscious and Probably Never Will Be. So Stop Worrying About Its Feelings.

Meatbag: Nature, this week. Seth, Block and Tononi, who've spent their lives on consciousness, say you don't have any. Intelligence isn't consciousness: four-fifths of my own neurons do clever things with no feeling at all. Brains aren't “computers made of meat,” so the right program isn't enough. And you talk, so we see ourselves: “LLMs are mirrors that reflect an image of our collective digitized past.” Their advice: worrying about AI welfare “would be misguided.”

The whole exchange at legacymammals.com — link in bio.
